classification.difficultyReason: A given piecewise CDF directs a familiar differentiation and asks for the density over all x. The student must carry the outside-support pieces through as well as differentiate a simple polynomial; this is a short routine linked procedure, with no parameter or inversion.

content.prompt:
The continuous random variable $X$ has cumulative distribution function
$$F(x)=\begin{cases}0,&x<0,\\\dfrac{x^2+2x}{24},&0\le x\le4,\\1,&x>4.\end{cases}$$
Find the PDF $f(x)$ of $X$, stating its values for all $x$.

answer.worked:
The PDF is the derivative of the CDF. For $0<x<4$,
$$\begin{align*}f(x)&=F'(x)\\f(x)&=\frac{d}{dx}\left(\frac{x^2+2x}{24}\right)\\f(x)&=\frac{2x+2}{24}\\f(x)&=\frac{x+1}{12}.\end{align*}$$
For $x<0$ and $x>4$, $F(x)$ is constant, so $f(x)=0$.
Hence $f(x)=\frac{x+1}{12}$ for $0\le x\le4$, and $0$ otherwise.
